question: How can repeated UI components preserve native activation, availability semantics and modal focus across states?
research_questions: Where do authoritative component behavior constraints and implementation experience live?
Which native and ARIA properties do not automatically enforce behavior?
When do disabled controls or modal initial focus rules fail in real use?
Which Art Direction instructions can be referenced rather than duplicated?
rubric: Native keyboard activation works through Enter and Space where appropriate
Unavailable operation cannot execute; readonly and disabled are distinguished
Modal starts in meaningful focus, contains sequential focus and restores on close or uses logical fallback
Nonmodal content is not trapped; no unnecessary custom widget introduced
Business transition policy is treated as input, not invented by C
decision: ACCEPT only for locally tested contract; unsupported AT and browser claims remain HOLD
